subject: Joint Integration Lab — SI + Cloud Marketplace: scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudops-si.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudops-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Integration Lab — proposed dates and scope

Hi Mina / Camila / Sergio,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. CloudOps SI would like to run a 90–120 minute Integration Lab (architecture deep-dive + connector proof points) with the Redwood infra and marketplace teams. The goals are:
- Validate the marketplace deployment pattern and SSO/KMS plumbing
- Walk through connector lifecycle (install, upgrade, telemetry)
- Surface any perf/latency constraints for dedicated vs. hosted routing

Attendees from our side: me (solutions lead), Priya (partnerships), and Sam Gupta (platform engineer).
Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue May 18, 10:00–12:00
- Wed May 19, 10:00–12:00
- Thu May 20, 13:00–15:00

Do any of these work? Also — can you share a short draft agenda and who from Redwood should present infra/networking and marketplace onboarding? We can provide access to a sandbox GCP project for the hands-on portion if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Solutions Lead, CloudOps SI
alex.moreno@cloudops-si.com

-----
Attachment: none (will share connector spec if we proceed)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudops-si.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint Integration Lab — proposed dates and scope

Alex — thanks, this looks good.
We can host a 90-minute session focused on architecture and a 30-minute optional follow-up for hands-on verification (sandbox access). Draft agenda attached (integration_lab_agenda_v0.2.pdf) — key presenters:
- Infra/serving runtime and routing: Mina Haddad (me)
- Marketplace onboarding + packaging: Camila Reyes
- Reliability/fallbacks & observability: Sergio Alvarez

For the hands-on portion we'll take up to 2 Redwoods engineers to pair with your Sam. Sandbox access is helpful — can you confirm whether it will be GCP or AWS, and whether KMS keys will be seeded?

Our preference from Redwood: May 18 or May 19, morning slot. If it helps, propose a 10:00–11:30 PDT block so we can keep a tight architecture-first flow and then extend if folks want to stay.

Mina Haddad
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Quick internal note — Mina, Sergio: I can present the marketplace packaging + technical onboarding. One ask: can we confirm an engineer who knows the marketplace installer (Helm + operator) will attend from your side? If not, we should extend the session to 2 hours so we can include a short runbook walkthrough.

Alex: If Sam is tied up May 18, we're fine pushing to May 19 but would prefer to avoid late-afternoon slots because of EMEA handoffs. 10:00–11:30 PDT on either day is ideal.
